draft.explanation: Starting with an initial portfolio of $250,000 compounding at a monthly rate of 0.55% (6.6% nominal annual), with scheduled end-of-month contributions of $1,500 for months 1–90 and $2,000 for months 91–180, plus a $50,000 withdrawal at month 60, the projected balance at month 180 is $1,091,695.51. Relative to the education target of $1,200,000, there is a shortfall of $108,304.49. To eliminate this shortfall over 180 months, an additional end-of-month contribution of $353.7412 per month is required, which rounds upward to $353.75 per month.
